description:
The 2025 Cadillac Escalade Sport delivers commanding presence and versatile capability for families and professionals who demand superior performance and accommodating interior space. This full-size luxury SUV combines refined engineering with practical functionality, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a vehicle that performs as impressively as it looks.

- 3rd Row Seven Passenger Seating
- 6.2L V8 Engine with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- Active Blind Spot Monitor
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration
- Autonomous Emergency Braking
- Digital Cockpit with Reconfigurable Head-Up Display
- AKG Studio 19-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM
- Panoramic Tilt-Sliding Sunroof
- Heated and Ventilated Leather Seats
- Navigation System with Hitch Guidance and Trailering App
- Lane Assist and Lane Departure Warning
- 22 Polished Finish Alloy Wheels
- Magnetic Ride Control Suspension
- Blind Zone Steering Assist with Trailering

The Sport's white exterior with Crystal White Tricoat finish presents a striking appearance while the well-appointed interior accommodates up to seven passengers with premium leather seating surfaces featuring precision perforated inserts. Heated and ventilated front seats combined with heated rear seats ensure comfort across all seating positions, while power adjustments for multiple seat zones allow each occupant to customize their position and support.

Advanced technology enhances both convenience and safety throughout your drive. The reconfigurable full-color head-up display keeps essential information visible without distracting from the road, while the digital cockpit provides comprehensive vehicle data at a glance. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you seamlessly linked to your devices, and the robust 19-speaker audio system delivers premium sound quality for every journey.

For those who tow or navigate challenging terrain, the Escalade Sport offers purposeful equipment including integrated trailer brake control, trailering app functionality, and hitch guidance with hitch view. The 2-speed active transfer case, magnetic ride control suspension, and electronic limited-slip differential work together to provide capable on-road and light off-road performance. Running board assist steps ease entry and exit for all passengers.

Safety systems throughout the vehicle include active blind spot monitoring, lane departure warning, autonomous emergency braking, and multi-stage airbag protection. Additional security features include a glass breakage sensor, theft-deterrent alarm system, and OnStar emergency communication capability. The power liftgate and hands-free operation enhance daily usability, while the backup camera provides clear views when reversing.

With 7,667 miles, this Escalade Sport has been meticulously maintained and remains essentially new. The 6.2L V8 engine delivers the performance expected from Cadillac's flagship SUV, achieving 14 city and 18 highway mpg. All power features, climate controls, and convenience systems operate flawlessly, ready to serve your family's needs immediately.

Visit our showroom to experience the commanding driving position, spacious three-row interior, and premium materials that define the Escalade Sport. Our team is prepared to discuss financing options, answer your questions, and ensure this vehicle meets your family's specific requirements.

One owner. Local trade. Only 88,820 miles. Nearly 100,000 miles below market average. This 2004 Honda Accord EX-L isn't simply an older Accord. It's the kind of remarkably low-mileage, long-term ownership example that's becoming increasingly difficult to find.

Think about that for a moment. This Accord is more than 20 years old and has averaged roughly 4,000 miles per year.

Finished in Satin Silver Metallic over a Black leather interior, it represents an era of Honda that many longtime owners still seek out today: simple engineering, excellent visibility, comfortable proportions, and drivetrains designed before turbochargers and increasingly complicated technology became commonplace.

Under the hood is Honda's naturally aspirated 2.4-liter i-VTEC four-cylinder paired with a traditional 5-speed automatic transmission with overdrive.

No turbocharger. No CVT. No hybrid system. Just Honda's proven four-cylinder engine, a conventional geared automatic, and front-wheel drive.

Despite that straightforward drivetrain, it still delivers an EPA-estimated 24 MPG city and 34 MPG highway, making it perfectly reasonable as an everyday commuter even today.

And this isn't a basic Accord.

The EX-L was one of the premium configurations of the lineup, bringing leather seating, heated front seats, an 8-way power driver's seat, a power moonroof, dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, remote keyless entry, cruise control, and 16-inch alloy wheels.

Even the audio system reflects the era, with a 120-watt six-speaker system and an in-dash six-disc CD changer. It's a small detail, but one that gives this Accord some genuine early-2000s character.

What really separates this car, however, isn't the equipment.

It's the history.

Finding a 2004 Accord is easy. Finding one that's remained with a single owner for more than two decades, was traded locally, and has accumulated only 88,820 miles is an entirely different proposition.

At this age, ownership history matters. A one-owner car tells a much more compelling story than one that has passed through five or six different owners, especially when the odometer is nearly 100,000 miles below market average.

For someone looking for an affordable commuter, first car, second household vehicle, or simply an older Honda from an era known for straightforward engineering, this is exactly the type of example worth paying attention to.

Offered by Honda of Kirkland, backed by more than 30 years of serving the greater Seattle and Kirkland communities.

If you've been looking for an older Accord, don't treat this like an ordinary 2004. One owner, local history, EX-L equipment, and only 88,820 miles make this Satin Silver Metallic Accord increasingly uncommon. Come see it at Honda of Kirkland and experience a remarkably preserved piece of classic Honda practicality before someone else recognizes what it is.

Discover the 2026 GMC Acadia Elevation, a three-row family SUV designed to accommodate your active lifestyle with confidence and comfort.

- 7-Passenger seating with 2-2-3 configuration
- Elevation Premium Package with power-adjustable front passenger seat
- Front passenger power lumbar adjuster for enhanced comfort
- 20 aluminum wheels with all-season tires
- Bose Premium 12-Speaker System with sub-woofer
- Navigation system with 15 diagonal premium infotainment display
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- 1st and 2nd row all-weather floor liners
- 3rd row all-weather floor liner

- 3-Channel programmable universal home remote
- CoreTec seat trim
- Front and rear molded splash guards

This Acadia arrives in sophisticated Black with Ebony Twilight Metallic finish, immediately setting it apart on the road. The Elevation Premium Package elevates your driving experience with heated front seats, a power liftgate, and dual-zone automatic climate control that keeps all three rows comfortable. The 8-way power driver seat and 6-way adjustable front passenger seat ensure that every occupant finds their ideal seating position.

The cabin is thoughtfully equipped for your daily needs. A 15-inch premium GMC infotainment system with navigation keeps you connected, while the Bose 12-speaker audio system with sub-woofer delivers quality sound for your commute or weekend drives. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration means your smartphone connects seamlessly for navigation, communication, and entertainment.

Handling and capability matter on every drive. The 2.5L DOHC engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive delivers practical efficiency, earning 20 mpg in the city and 26 mpg on the highway. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering provides responsive handling across all road conditions. Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and multiple airbags throughout the cabin.

Practical features address real-world demands. All-weather floor liners protect your investment across all three rows, while the integrated cargo liner and power liftgate simplify loading. The universal home remote means convenient garage door control without leaving your seat. Molded front and rear splash guards protect against debris, and the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility during inclement weather.

This low-mileage 2026 Acadia Elevation represents your opportunity to own a well-equipped, dependable three-row family vehicle ready for whatever comes next. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience its space, comfort, and capability firsthand.

All Star Edition Plus brings towing-focused enhancements and helpful trailering aids so hitching and hauling feel more confident and less stressful.

Safety Package concentrates on situational awareness and collision-mitigation technology to make close-quarters driving and busy roads easier to manage.

Leather Package upgrades seating surfaces and cabin touches for a more polished, comfortable environment on long trips and everyday commutes.

Protection Package helps preserve the pickup bed from wear and weather, keeping the cargo area looking better and protecting resale value.

Convenience Package II focuses on trailer-ready conveniences that reduce the hassle of connecting, testing and monitoring a trailer during towing.

Remote Start Package lets you warm up or cool down the interior from a distance so you step into a comfortable truck no matter the weather.

Preferred Equipment Group 1LT bundles core capability and comfort features balancing utility, connectivity and driver aids for everyday versatility.

Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto mirror your phone wirelessly so navigation, calls and music are available on the Silverado s screen without tangled cords.

Forward collision mitigation monitors the road ahead and can intervene when a frontal impact risk is detected to help reduce the chance or severity of a crash.

Front pedestrian impact prevention constantly scans for people in front of the truck and takes steps to avoid or lessen collisions with pedestrians.

Onboard mobile hotspot capability keeps passengers connected with in-vehicle Wi-Fi so devices can stay online without relying on individual phone plans.

Lane departure prevention watches lane position and can nudge the vehicle back to center, taking some of the strain out of long highway stretches.

*Smart device mirroring* brings your phone s navigation, media and messaging into the cabin display so you can find what you need quickly while minimizing distraction.

*Front pedestrian impact prevention* provides an extra layer of awareness by monitoring the road ahead and intervening if a potential pedestrian collision is detected.

*Automatic curve slowdown cruise control* uses route data to gently reduce speed for tight turns and hills, helping maintain a steadier, less tiring highway pace.

*Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go* keeps a safe following distance and can bring the vehicle to a stop and resume as traffic flows, easing congested commutes.

*Brake assist* boosts braking force during sudden stops so the system can help shorten stopping distances when swift action is needed.

Steering wheel mounted cruise controls let you set and adjust speed without taking your hands off the wheel, keeping comfort and control within easy reach.

The *head-up display* projects key driving info onto the windshield so you can check speed and alerts with less eye movement from the road ahead.

A powered open-and-close liftgate simplifies loading and unloading when your hands are full, making errands and family outings smoother and faster.

*Ventilated front seats* and heated third-row seating expand comfort for everyone: cool air at the front on hot days and targeted warmth for rear passengers in cold weather.

Combining a refined 3.8L V6, an 8-speed automatic and a thoughtful suite of safety, comfort and connectivity features across three rows, the 2024 Hyundai Palisade Limited FWD is built for practical family life and long-distance comfort. *Sequential multi-point electronic fuel injection* meters fuel precisely to each cylinder, supporting smoother starts, reliable operation and efficient combustion.

*Wireless audio streaming* lets you wirelessly play music and podcasts from your phone through the stereo for easier, cord-free entertainment on the road.

Dual-zone front HVAC gives driver and front passenger independent temperature control so both can travel comfortably without compromising the other s comfort.

Altogether, the 2014 Subaru Outback Limited combines well-considered comfort features with Subaru s capable drivetrain to create a practical, year-round wagon equally at home on daily commutes and weekend escapes.
